rifle-butt-smash-escape.head: 93267c902cc095a9a5222d77ab670d4794ffb854
rifle-butt-smash-escape.scope: Stock native win and armor retest. The first win needed no roll adjustment; the second used the one-shot fixture aid. The earlier stock run verified at-rest refusal and natural losses and a tie. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/982#issuecomment-7106298381

504.note: PR974 stock verifies the delayed Stun and both independent four-second lifetimes with a fixture-controlled marker roll. Armor piercing, historical damage and the full direct attack contest remain open. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/974#issuecomment-7107539672

controls.source: GOB 504 supplies a 30% 0.1-second marker with value four. ApplyStunWithTimer installs Stun 102, whose initializer links Combat Tactics 163 −20, and separate immunity.
controls.runtime: The landed marker expires and installs the four-second state without extending immunity or replacing a protected active Stun. The linked modifier is removed with the state.
controls.test: ConcealedShotStunLowersBothAttackInputsAndRemovesTheSameLinkedRecord and ConcealedAndSniperShotsUseTheirOwnDelayedStunProbabilities verify attack inputs, chance, immunity and expiry. Stock verifies 504/504, 504/102, 102/0, 102/163 and 734/681 with matched removals and both localized notices. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/974#issuecomment-7107539672

453.note: The original tactical-value producer for the stored +11 remains unresolved. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/982#issuecomment-7107445297

damage.source: Current GOB 453 stores fixed Ballistic base 6. The old inactive direct-object hook has a different amount and does not define the current route.
damage.runtime: Only a winning withdrawal deals the ordinary typed ballistic ability hit before the fight ends.
damage.test: The stock unadjusted win hit for 7 and the armored retest observed raw 7, final 6 with +20 Ballistic Resistance. Unassisted losses and a tie dealt no 453 damage. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/982#issuecomment-7107445297 https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/982#issuecomment-7106298381

targeting.source: GOB 453 is a selected enemy rifle escape with TestFunction 6 and a 16 m selector.
targeting.runtime: The loaded ability binds the current rifle interlock opponent and rechecks spawn, weapon and style. The withdrawal path resolves against the opponent roll.
targeting.test: RifleButtSmashQueuesOnlyAgainstItsCurrentOpponent verifies at rest, wrong weapon/style, unloaded and stale opponent refusal. RifleEscapeUsesTheTacticalComparisonInsteadOfOrdinaryHits verifies win/loss/tie. Both stock runs verify original opponent, refusals and no redirection. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/982#issuecomment-7106298381 https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/982#issuecomment-7107445297

choreography.source: The shipped Rifle RifleButt move is 11356. GOB TestFunction 6 identifies an escape.
choreography.runtime: The ordinary withdrawal outcome emits 0x100 and the special move on success. Lost and tied attempts continue the normal exchange.
choreography.test: Both native wins played 11356, withdrew, removed both sides’ interlock locks and restored movement. Natural losses and a tie played ordinary exchanges and stayed in combat. https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/982#issuecomment-7107445297 https://github.com/kylebrussell/mxo-hd/pull/982#issuecomment-7106298381
